dedupe_keys.name: open data package for great britain power grid modelling and gic simulation

description: This data package supports open, national-scale modelling of the Great Britain power grid for space weather studies. It was published by Wen Chen, Ding Yuan, Aleksandr Rubtsov and co-authors with a manuscript submitted to Geophysical Research Letters. It includes power infrastructure data derived from OpenStreetMap, the modelled 400 kV and 275 kV grid topology, validation results for substations and transmission lines, comparisons of modelled substation-level geomagnetically induced currents (GIC) with reference values, and sensitivity results for grounding resistance and branch resistance. Coverage is the GB extra-high-voltage transmission network. Files are one ZIP of about 1.7 MB on Zenodo (September 2026), with network data derived from OpenStreetMap under the Open Database License 1.0. Caveats: the topology is inferred from crowdsourced map data and validated against reference information described in the manuscript, and grounding parameters are assumptions tested by sensitivity analysis. Simulation uses are geomagnetic storm hazard assessment and GIC risk to transformers. Related records: none linked on the provider's pages read on the day.
